review.notes: No code fences exist in the OCR markdown, so fence balance is trivially intact; heading tree matches the PDF section structure with no spurious figure-banner or prompt-box headings. Automated per-page droppage scan of all 44 physical pages (normalized 5-word window containment) triaged the flagged lines: flagged equation lines on pp.12/14/16/17/21/22 are present in the OCR with LaTeX-equivalent notation (equations 2, 4, 11-18 verified by reading the OCR); flagged architecture-diagram labels and subcaptions on pp.7/10-13/15/19 belong to embedded figure images. Real drops are four page-bottom footnote bodies (title-page asterisk note on p.1 and numbered footnotes 1-3 on pp.11/21/29) whose superscript markers survive, plus the p.38 bottom note; all restored after visually reading rendered pages 1, 11, 21, 29 and 38 at 120 dpi, with the beta-marker equation line re-read at 300 dpi. The doubled 'Furthermore, we apply data augmentation...' sentence on p.17 is printed by the PDF itself and was left unchanged. The p.38 text-layer glyphs extracted as 1/2/OEM marks are colored icon bullets in print, so their absence is not a text defect. Figure captions (27) and table captions (14) all have their embed/table present; remaining prose pages were machine-scanned only.
